cash_breakdown.reason: RMB112.56 million current and RMB19.95 million non-current borrowings.

cash_breakdown.reason: Unsecured, non-interest bearing and repayable on demand.

cash_breakdown.reason: Retained for ordinary operations and project execution, not detachable.

profit_quality.assessment: The business is profitable, but distributable cash is materially weaker than accounting profit because receivables are very large, 2025 trade receivables increased sharply, and capex rose to RMB56.7 million.
adjustments: Used three-year operating cash flow evidence instead of the best accounting profit year.
Started from 2024-2025 operating cash flow level and deducted estimated RMB20.0 million maintenance capex.
Applied 0.55 profit haircut because receivables represented a large portion of assets and operating cash flow/capex did not support full conversion of reported profit into distributable cash.
profit_quality.cashflow_support: Operating cash flow was RMB23.887 million in 2023, RMB60.518 million in 2024 and RMB62.498 million in 2025; 2025 capex was RMB56.723 million.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: Positive but incomplete cash conversion, high receivable concentration and rising software platform capex.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: Three-year median operating cash flow divided by median parent profit is about 0.876, but 2025 receivables rose by RMB181.0 million.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: Maintenance capex is not disclosed; RMB20.0 million is used as a conservative normalized estimate below 2025 reported capex but above pre-expansion levels.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: Working capital volatility is already reflected in operating cash flow and the 0.55 profit haircut; not separately deducted again in the main denominator.

limitations: Market cap is from the rough screen input and was not independently re-priced during this run.
Annual report does not split cash between listed parent and PRC operating subsidiaries; cash haircut is therefore conservative.
Maintenance capex is estimated because the filing discloses total capex but not maintenance versus growth capex.
Receivables are large and recoverability was a key audit matter, so profit-to-cash quality remains the main uncertainty.
